runtime_pipeline: Seven separately generated transparent originals are alpha-trimmed onto 1254px source masters and Lanczos-downscaled to one 128px emblem and six 64px chapter seals. Source masters are excluded from release packages.

assets.non_color_identity: An open asymmetrical field atlas carries six materially distinct clasps around a pale compass-seed flame.
A split basalt chimney and four ember vanes curve around an empty bronze censer.
Two unequal crescent shells rise around a dark mirror basin rooted into a reed-wrapped landing.
Two asymmetric prism sails and three crystal keels frame an offset oval lens.
Unequal living-root antlers surround a hollow seed dais and three hanging seed lanterns.
Three brass pressure rings carry a diagonal drill rail, two blank gauges, and a red relief valve.
A drowned bell hangs beneath a tilted whalebone arch above two tideglass pools and a hooked keel stair.
